The '''Jjannex sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] between the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Spine]] and the intersection of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. Both the [[Lipsec Run/Legends|Lipsec Run]] and the [[Nothoiin Corridor]] passed through it.
